supporting_pages.title: Explore BigQuery in the Google Cloud console \_|\_ Google Cloud Documentation
evidence_snippets: Files tab of the left pane ( Preview ): use the Files tab to organize code assets such as saved queries and notebooks by using folders.
The Studio page has the following components: Explorer tab of the left pane : use the Explorer tab to work with tables, views, routines, and other BigQuery resources, and view your job history .
Go to Studio Alternatively, enter the following URL in your browser: https://console.cloud.google.com/bigquery The Studio page opens in your most recently accessed project.

supporting_pages.title: Create and use tables \_|\_ BigQuery \_|\_ Google Cloud Documentation
evidence_snippets: Interpret the results In the Logs Explorer result pane, expand the entry you're interested in, and then click Expand nested fields to show the whole message.
Go to the BigQuery page In the left pane, click explore Explorer : If you don't see the left pane, click last page Expand left pane to open the pane.
In the Explorer pane, expand your project, click Datasets , and then select a dataset.

supporting_pages.title: Using Connected Sheets \_|\_ BigQuery \_|\_ Google Cloud Documentation
evidence_snippets: Go to BigQuery In the left pane, click explore Explorer : In the Explorer pane, expand your project and click Queries .

If you have the required allow permissions and meet the VPC Service Controls access restrictions, you can configure the VPC Service Controls perimeter to allow queries issued through Connected Sheets.
In the Explorer pane, expand your project, click Datasets , and then click the dataset that contains the table that you want to open in Google Sheets.
